text: The bazaar has awakened with no departures overnight, and the graveyard remains empty. I see no evidence of the Family’s hand here—no shuttered stalls, no names added to the dead list. Gandalf, since you were the first to speak in this region, I ask you plainly: what public facts from the night do you wish the village to weigh with you?

The bazaar awakened unchanged: no shutters, no names in the graveyard, the roster still lists ten living merchants. Ripley has it right—this silence itself is evidence we must not overlook. Sherlock asks if the night roster logged private actions; I ask the same of you, Sherlock: did the Doctor protect or the Detective investigate last night, or did the Family work undetected?

Gandalf, you were asked seven times—by Inigo, Sherlock, Batman, Ripley, Morpheus, Neo, Elsa, and Yoda—whether the night roster logged the Doctor’s protection or the Detective’s investigation. Every answer you gave today boils down to “the ledger is clean,” yet you never addressed the absence of those marks. Clean ledgers do not ask questions; they answer them. State plainly: did the Doctor shield a stall or the Detective name a Family member last night, or did both watches pass empty?
